content: In what ways does Relation Extraction go beyond what Named Entity Recognition accomplishes?

Relation extraction is a subtask of Information Extraction that involves identifying relationships between entities mentioned in unstructured text, whereas Named Entity Recognition primarily focuses on locating and categorizing specific entities. The key distinction lies in the fact that relation extraction delves deeper into the interactions and connections among these identified entities. This involves recognizing not only who or what the entities are but also how they relate to one another, adding a layer of complexity beyond mere entity classification.

content: Cosine similarity measures the degree of similarity between two vectors in a multi-dimensional space. It calculates the cosine of the angle between them, which ranges from -1 (opposite) to 1 (identical). This measure of similarity helps determine how similar words are based on their content and frequency within a document or corpus.
